]
(Declined in classical language only
in pl.; आपः, अपः, अद्भिः, अद्भ्यः अपां and
अप्सु, but in singular and pl. in Veda)
1 Water (regarded in Ved. as sacred
divinities, आपो देवीः); खानि चैव
स्पृशेदद्भिः

. Water is generally
considered to be the first of the 5
elements of creation, as in अप एव
ससर्जादौ तासु बीजमवासृजत्

it is said to have
been created from ज्योतिस् or तेजस्
after मनस्, आकाश, वायु and ज्योतिस् or
अग्नि; ज्योतिषश्च विकुर्वाणादापो रसगुणाः स्मृताः ।
अद्भ्यो गंधगुणा भूमिरित्येषा सृष्टिरादितः ॥
--2
Air, the intermediate region.
--3
The star Ś virginis. For the changes
of अप् at the end of comp. see

-98. [cf. L. aqua,
Gr. appos; Lith. uppe; Goth. ahva;
Pers. ab; Zend ap; Old Germ. aha].
--Comp.
--कृत्स्नं deep meditation by
means of water.
--चरः an aquatic
animal.
--पतिः {1} ‘Lord of waters’,
N. of Varuṇa. {2} the ocean. For
other comps. see s. v.

; so फलं, कीर्ति, सुखं &c.
--2 To reach,
go to; overtake, meet, fall in with;
शबरीमापतुर्वने

.
--3 To
pervade, occupy, enter into.
--4 To
undergo, suffer, meet with;
दिष्टांतमाप्स्यति भवान्

.
--5 To equal. --pass. (आप्यते)
1 To
be reached, found, met with,
obtained &c.
--2 To arrive at one's
end or aim.
--3 To become filled.
--Caus. (आपयति)
1 To cause to
reach or obtain.
--2 To cause any
one to feel or perceive.
--3 To hit.
